meta.title: Local Building Authority And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 4 of 2021 authorizing the redemption of Lease Revenue Bonds Series 2013A and 2014A and related matters.
votes.description: Authorizes the redemption of certain outstanding lease revenue bonds issued by the Local Building Authority, which were related to the construction of the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Local Building Authority and reconvene as the City Council.
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the Local Building Authority meeting and transition to the Salt Lake City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Approve Work Session meeting minutes of Tuesday, November 10, 2020, and meeting minute excerpts relating to the Airport Bond Resolution actions from Tuesday, June 1, 2021, and Tuesday, July 13, 2021.
votes.description: Approves prior work session and special meeting minutes related to City Council proceedings and Airport Bond Resolution actions.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and adopt Ordinance 45 of 2021, a rezone of the property at approximately 329-331 South and 600 East (Encircle) from RMF-35 to R-MU-35.
votes.description: Rezones the Encircle Family and Youth Services Center property to allow a café eatery within the existing building, which was not permitted under the prior zoning designation.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Goshen Street Alley Vacation).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed vacation of a City-owned alley at approximately 740 South Goshen Street and defers the final decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Rosewood Park Street and Alley Vacation at 1400 North 1200 West).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed vacation of unimproved City-owned alleys and streets within Rosewood Park and defers the final decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Administrative Decision Appeals Text Amendment).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed zoning ordinance amendments clarifying the administrative appeals process and defers the final decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing, ask the Planning Staff to return with a few potential recommendations that may mitigate the impact of outdoor dining on adjacent residential uses and address the red lines from Verizon Wireless (Special Exception Process Text Amendment).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed elimination of the special exception process from the zoning ordinance and directs Planning Staff to return with recommendations addressing outdoor dining impacts on residential uses and Verizon Wireless concerns.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing (Capital Improvement Program Projects).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the FY2022 Capital Improvement Program project funding allocations, with final action deferred to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the appointment of Kristin Riker as the Director of the Public Lands Department.
votes.description: Confirms the Mayor's appointment of Kristin Riker to lead the City's Public Lands Department.

votes.motion: Ratify the Chair's determination to continue meeting remotely and without an anchor location.
votes.description: Ratifies the Council Chair's decision to hold meetings electronically without a physical anchor location due to ongoing health and safety concerns and closure of the City and County Building to the public.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 29 of 2021, entering into Addendum Number 4 and Addendum Number 5 to the Interlocal Agreement with the Utah Transit Authority, and placing the remaining $175,261 into a holding account reserved for future Funding Our Future transit expenses.
votes.description: Authorizes the Mayor to execute two new addenda to the City's interlocal agreement with UTA, continuing East-West connecting bus routes and initiating mobilization on Route 1 (1000 North) as part of the Frequent Transit Network implementation.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 26 of 2021, authorizing up to $26,100,000 of sales and excise tax revenue and refunding bonds and providing for related matters.
votes.description: Authorizes the issuance of up to $26.1 million in sales and excise tax revenue refunding bonds to finance the acquisition of library facilities from the Local Building Authority and refund certain outstanding bonds.

Approves multiple items on the consent agenda including setting public hearing dates for several ordinances, board appointments for Scott Lyttle and Mike Pazzi, and reappointments of Jeff Worthington and Brandon Dew to the Citizens' Compensation Advisory Committee.
